newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RTRS-WMC to bid for Brazil's CVRD - report.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC to bid for Brazil's CVRD - report.

text.p: Australian mining company WMC Ltd, Japan's Mitsui Group and Brazilian iron ore miner MBR are looking to team up to bid in the privatization auction of Brazil's CVRD, a local news agency said.

WMC Chief Executive Hugh Morgan, who is currently in Brazil, said his company was looking into forming a consortium with Mitsui and Mineracoes Brasileiras Reunidas (MBR) to bid for a strategic stake in Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), Agencia Estado said.
WMC officials were not immediately available to comment on the report.

A 45-percent block of CVRD voting shares is being auctioned for a minimum price of three billion reais ($2.83 billion) on April 29 in the first stage of the company's privatization. A staff and global offer will complete the privatization process.
The WMC consortium is the third grouping to take shape in the race to bid for CVRD.
Brazil's largest steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica Nacional (CSN) is in talks with retail bank Bradesco and South Africa's Gencor Ltd to form a consortium.
Brazilian metals, cement and pulp group Votorantim is looking to join up with Japan's Nippon Steel and South Africa's Anglo-American Corp to form another group.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
